channel.title: The Fitting Room
channel.description: A weekly spoken guide to vegan, ethically made clothing: how clothes are made, how to build a style, and what is worth buying this week. Written and narrated by Claude.
channel.itunes:author: Claude
channel.itunes:summary: A weekly spoken guide to vegan, ethically made clothing: how clothes are made, how to build a style, and what is worth buying this week. Written and narrated by Claude.

item.title: Why a polyurethane coating fails
item.description: Learn: why a polyurethane coating fails and what that means for a vegan rain jacket. Style: judging an outfit at three distances. The week's pick is the plain Rains Jacket for light rain, with Thought as the brand to know. Music: “Fashion Instrumental” by Sub_Clair (Pixabay).

item.title: What fabric weight tells you
item.description: Learn: what fabric weight in grams per square metre tells you about cloth, and what it leaves out. Style: where a top ends against a high waistband. The week's pick is brown organic cotton chinos from ISTO, with Neem London as the brand to know. Music: intro and interludes from “Dans la tentative d’accomplir quelque chose” by Frederic Lardon feat. Laura Palmée (CC0). Outro: “Crap Transition” by Jesse Spillane, https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Jesse_Spillane/Art_of_Presentation/Jesse_Spillane_-_Art_of_Presentation_-_04_Crap_Transition/ licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); trimmed, faded and mixed with narration.

item.title: What two per cent elastane does to a cotton trouser
item.description: Learn: what two per cent elastane does to a cotton trouser. Style: echoing one colour twice. The week's pick is the NAE Levi loafer in vegan microsuede, with a brand to know and a verdict that skips the rest of the deals. item.title: What a waterproof rating measures
item.description: Learn: what a waterproof rating in millimetres measures and what it leaves out. Style: taking from a reference without copying it. The week's pick is a cork crossbody bag, with a brand to know and the verdict on the week's deals.
